text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival! It's an event where the 
Umamusume tackle various competitions to 
entertain the fans who support them.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-san, thank you so much for 
agreeing to pair up with me!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"I don't mind. I had some free time 
anyway. ...But why me?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
To think I'd get to pair up with 
Sweep-san, whom I admire so much... Urgh, 
I'm so moved!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is this really the time to be getting 
emotional?! Shape up! We're gonna seize 
this victory together!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Buena-san, I might end up leaning on you 
a lot today, but... let's do our best and 
win!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's win and go report to Spe-san 
together♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Shakur-san. Why did you agree to 
help me?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm gonna be forced to participate 
anyway. Doesn't matter what event I'm in."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—...So yeah, all my rivals ended up 
entering the doubles events with girls 
they're close to.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Which means so will I! I knew right then 
that I absolutely had to enter, too!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...If that's the case, all the more 
reason: why me? We don't have much of a 
connection—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You helped me back in the Junior Class, 
didn't you? Teaching me how to run while 
conserving my stamina.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
When we ran side-by-side that time... I 
felt like we clicked so well!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone looks wonderful, but our pair is 
definitely the most awesome♪"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I wouldn't know about that. However, I 
will thoroughly carry out the job I was 
asked to do."

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Once again, high-profile pairs have 
gathered for the 'Anything Goes Showdown'! 
The pair that clears each unique event and 
racks up the highest total score will take 
home the victory!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
First up is the "Tie-Breaker Showdown"! 
The mark of a great pair is being on the 
same wavelength! The pair that keeps 
throwing ties the longest wins!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Rock, paper, scissors, go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait, why did you lose!? Throw a tie like 
you're supposed to~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I'm sorry! I just really didn't want 
you to lose, Sweep-san...!
choice_data_list:
(Everyone's having a pretty tough time, 
but—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —Rock, paper, scissors, shoot!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Another tie! ...Hehe, that makes ten 
times!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Our next event is the 'Charades Quiz'! If 
your bond is strong, it should be a 
breeze!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Um... Uhhh...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—I've got it! The answer is... Tanino 
Gimlet!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I guess it really could look like 
that...! The correct answer 
was—'Gentildonna'-san.
choice_data_list:
(So the theme is the academy's students, 
huh...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Okay, I get it. What we need is... 
that!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. "Durandal"-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That's absolutely right!
choice_data_list: (Whoa...! Got it right on the first try!)

text_block_list.name: Observer D
text_block_list.text:
"A-Are we really that chaotic!? I would 
think we look much more gallant!"

text_block_list.name: Observer K
text_block_list.text:
Wachandhal is already acting all restless. 
Calm down, wacha-wacha.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
“—And now, for the final event! Vying for 
the top score right now are...! The pair 
of Daring Heart and Believe, and—”

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Tied for first place is the Air Messiah & 
Air Shakur pair!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... I was supposed to lose right 
away...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Those two seem to understand each other 
pretty well. But... I don't feel like 
losing at all!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The final event is—"Can You Guess the 
Sound?". We'll be creating a fictional 
sound, so please make sure both of your 
answers match!
choice_data_list:
(A totally incomprehensible curveball 
question out of nowhere...!)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
An imaginary sound...? There's no way I 
can answer that.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That's not true! If we tap into our 
instincts, I'm sure we can find the 
answer――let's do it!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm gonna play a made-up sound! 
—Here it comes!

text_block_list.name: Imaginary Sound
choice_data_list:
(...I don't get it at all! Is this even a 
sound!?)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(...Honestly, I don't get this at all! I 
don't get it, but still――)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: (If it's Believe-san, I'm sure...!)

text_block_list.name: Heart & Believe
text_block_list.text:
The answer is... —"March of the Zombies"! 
—"Voices of Ghosts"...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Aaaagh! A culture clash right here, right 
now...!

—The winners were the pair who matched 
their answers to this difficult question: 
Air Messiah & Air Shakur. Daring Heart was 
left frustrated.

text_block_list.name: Heart & Believe
text_block_list.text:
The answer is... "The Sound of a Hammer 
Striking"!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "We did it!! You did it, Believe!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... you adjusted your pace for 
me?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes. There was a metallic sound, so I 
figured that's what you'd answer, 
Believe-san!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I'm glad we went on the offensive! 
We truly were the most awesome, weren't 
we?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I still can't say for sure, but... if 
I lived up to your expectations, then I'm 
glad."

And so, the team of Daring Heart and 
Believe splendidly took the crown in the 
"Anything-Goes Showdown"!
